lines.text: David cries out for God to save him because the waters are up to his neck and his throat is parched.
David's enemies hate him without cause, and he has become a stranger to his brothers because zeal for God's house consumed him.
David wept and fasted and wore sackcloth, and the people at the gate honored him, so he prayed to the LORD.

wrong_details.wrong: the people at the gate honored him
wrong_details.true: those who sit at the gate mock him

lines.text: David asks God to rescue him from the mire, but he found many comforters, and his enemies gave him vinegar to drink.

wrong_details.true: he looked for comforters, but found no one

lines.text: David will praise God in song, and God will save Zion and rebuild the cities of Judah.
